title: AndroidAPS 2.8.2.1 / Warning has wrong units
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
- Units: mmol/l selected from Preferences
- Changing local profile targets under 5.0 mmol/l --> 4,8 - 4,8 
- Error "_Value maxBg is out of hard limits. 86,40 limited to 90,00_" appears with wrong units- --> This error should have correct units depending what units are selected from preferences . 
- Build version AAPS 2.8.2.1
